text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I peer into the dance studio and see<n>Seeking the
Pearl together with El<n>Condor Pasa, practicing
dance<n>moves.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: One, two, one, two! Now turn!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué haces?! Are you sure that's the<n>next move?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Don't fuss over the details, El! Come<n>on, put some
passion into that turn!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: O-okay! Turn!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Let your feelings guide your step!<n>Picture in your
mind our blazing<n>passion taking flight and soaring
through the skies!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Wh-what...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Okay, El! Now imagine the two of us<n>in magnificent
outfits, standing before<n>endless fields of green that
stretch<n>out beneath the infinite sky!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Our passion will reach all the way to<n>that distant
horizon!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: A-all right! I'll dance with blazing<n>passion!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's the spirit! Just concentrate<n>on
expressing the emotions bursting<n>forth from within!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: We can soar as high and far as we<n>desire!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: All right! I'm goin' all out and soarin'<n>into the sky!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad they're both having fun, but<n>it seems
they've strayed quite a bit<n>from the actual routine.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Bravo, El! Thank you for that<n>impassioned dance!
choice_data_list:
That was drastically different from the original
choreography, though...

That was drastically different from the original
choreography, though...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha. That may be so, but a live<n>performance is all
about sharing your<n>passion with fans!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's nothing more important than<n>expressing
the emotion that pours<n>from your heart!
choice_data_list: You have a point. Passion is important.

Inspiring people with a synchronized dance is
another form of passion.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! Let's keep this up and polish<n>our
expressive abilities!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Roger that!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but... won't everyone else on<n>stage get mad if
we're not doing the<n>same moves as them?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I suppose it would be uncouth to<n>disrupt the
harmony of the<n>performance.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Well then, how about busting out<n>some freestyle
moves during the<n>interlude? People sometimes do
their<n>own thing then, right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We can use that time to express<n>ourselves to our
hearts' content!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Qué bien! That's a great idea! I'll<n>follow your lead
to the ends of the<n>earth!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the two of them create a<n>dance routine
overflowing with<n>passion.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...I see. That makes sense. Somebody<n>must have
put a lot of effort into<n>choreographing this group
performance.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In that case, it's our job to take that<n>enthusiasm
and refine it to an even<n>purer form!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that was some spot-on advice,<n>Trainer! Let's
get back to practicing<n>the original choreography!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...Er, what was the next move after<n>that last step
again?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Pearl, don't tell me you were doing a<n>different
dance 'cause you forgot the<n>steps!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha! There's no need to dig up<n>trivial matters like
that, El!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Following that, Seeking the Pearl<n>learns the correct
choreography from<n>El Condor Pasa, and they
master the<n>dance moves for the performance.
